(salicin) Pharmacopoeias. In Eur. (see p.vii). Ph. Eur. 6.2 (Willow Bark). The whole or fragmented dried bark of young branches or whole dried pieces of current year twigs of various species of the genus Salix, including Salix purpurea, S. daphnoides, and S. fragilis. It contains not less than 1.5% of total salicylic derivatives, expressed as salicin (C13H18O7 = 286.3), calculated with reference to the dried drug. Protect from light.
